# Kudra Mohammed

> Founder and CEO of NIZARLINE, business strategist, corporate trainer and speaker based in St. Louis, Missouri. Almost a decade across luxury brand management (OMEGA, Lancome), retail leadership, sales performance, customer experience and entrepreneurship.

## Expertise
- Luxury sales and clienteling
- Brand strategy and market positioning
- Customer experience and service excellence
- Leadership, entrepreneurship and women in business

## Services
Keynote speaking, corporate workshops, sales and employee training, business strategy consulting.

## Works with
Corporations, luxury brands, retail companies, hospitality businesses, entrepreneurs, universities and professional organizations.
